in_use_evidence: No tool outside the run reads gigacron.feature at 2ed84b9: git grep finds no gherkin, behave or pytest-bdd in CI, pre-commit or packages, and spec-lint does not catch the error.
why: The file does not parse, so no Gherkin tool can read any Rule in it, which fails the purpose of the shared feature file; nothing outside the run parses it yet.

in_use_evidence: Reviewed text, todo.md T-0052: 'The entity model defines a generated config_hash column on TASK_VERSION'. Story on dev, backlog/ST-0003B.md:119-121: 'config_hash ship as deviations from entity-model.md for now - see T-0052'; ST-0003F.md:69 repeats it for runs_until.
why: The todo items contradict the accepted entity model, and stories on dev (ST-0003B, ST-0003F) already point at them, so a planner who cuts the Folder stories builds the wrong schema.
rule_gap: The rule 'stories or code outside the run encode its statement' does not say whether a story that only cites a todo item as a pointer encodes the statement.

in_use_evidence: No story or code at 7cd01b2 says the per-draft route of interface-contracts.md:132; backlog/ST-0003B.md:25 and routes.py::publish_task_drafts do the batch route /api/v1/publications, which differs from the statement.
why: Spec and delivered code name two publication routes, so the implementer of the next publication check cannot tell which contract to build without asking the stakeholder.
rule_gap: In use: no rule says how to treat a document statement that code on dev contradicts instead of encoding.

in_use_evidence: Fix branch is a stakeholder choice. interface-contracts.md:208 ('one problem for each field error') matches code in definition_store_service.py, but the per-draft rules (validation-rules.md:46, :98) that the other branch changes are encoded by no story or code. rule_gap: In use: 'the statement is the text that the Fix line changes' does not settle a finding whose Fix offers two alternative statements.
